تستكرهوا (form X)
# تَسْتَكْرِهُوا (tastakrihū) /tas.tak.ri.huː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
# تُسْتَكْرَهُوا (tustakrahū) /tus.tak.ra.huː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
